meta.title: Makhmakh — AI-powered learning from your own material
meta.description: Makhmakh turns your lecture files into ordered concepts, a study map and an assistant that answers from your own content.

common.tagline: Study smarter, from your own material
common.offlineHint: Could not reach the server. Make sure the backend is running, then try again.

hero.title: Upload your lecture. Makhmakh makes sense of it.
hero.subtitle: Turn your study files — PDF, slides, audio or video — into ordered concepts, plain-language explanations and an assistant that answers from your own material, with visible sources.
hero.trustLine: Everything you upload belongs to your own study space — nobody else sees or queries it.

problem.title: The problem we solve
problem.body: The lecture runs two hours, the file is thirty pages and the exam is next week. Rearranging material and hunting for one answer eats more time than actually studying.
points: Lots of files, repeated information, no clear structure
Hard to know where to start and what depends on what
Generic tools answer in generalities instead of your syllabus

features.title: What Makhmakh does for you
features.subtitle: Every feature works on your actual material — no invented numbers, no filler statistics.

upload.title: Simple file upload
upload.body: Accepts PDF, PowerPoint, Word and TXT plus audio and video from your lectures, and verifies the real file content rather than trusting the extension.

understand.title: Genuine content understanding
understand.body: Text is split into chunks and indexed semantically, so search works on meaning instead of keyword matching.

concepts.title: Concept map and study order
concepts.body: Makhmakh extracts the concepts and their prerequisite links, then orders them into a study path that starts in the right place.

assistant.title: An assistant with sources
assistant.body: Ask anything and get an answer grounded in your course material, with the passages it relied on shown alongside.

lessons.title: A lesson per concept
lessons.body: Each concept gets a written explanation that can be rendered into audio and a short video you can revisit any time.

progress.title: Track your progress
progress.body: Mark concepts as done and follow your completion rate inside every subject, one step at a time.

space.title: 1 — Create your study space
space.body: A private space for one subject. Yours alone, and you can create as many as you need.

upload.title: 2 — Upload your files
upload.body: Drag in lectures and summaries; Makhmakh processes them in the background and orders the content.

learn.title: 3 — Ask and study
learn.body: Walk the concept map, play a lesson, and ask the assistant at any point.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: The questions students ask most before they start with Makhmakh.

items.q: Who can see the files I upload?
items.a: Files belong to the study space you created. Content is indexed inside that course, and the assistant only answers from the material available in the course you are studying.
Documents: PDF, DOCX, PPTX, PPT and TXT. Media: MP3 and WAV for audio, MP4 and MOV for video. Audio files are transcribed automatically.

items.q: What is the maximum file size?
items.a: The default maximum is 100 MB per file, and file contents are inspected to confirm they match the declared type.

items.q: Where do the assistant's answers come from?
items.a: From the material in the course you uploaded. The closest passages are retrieved first, then the answer is generated with its sources shown. If the material is not enough, it says so plainly instead of inventing.

items.q: Does it work well in Arabic?
items.a: Yes. The platform is Arabic-first and the whole interface is RTL. The assistant replies in the language of your question and uses colloquial Arabic when you do.

items.q: Can I use it on my phone?
items.a: Yes. Every screen is built responsively for phones and tablets, with touch-friendly navigation.
